title: dryopteris subspinulosa
intro: Dryopteris subspinulosa, commonly known as Spiny Wood Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris subspinulosa are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and analgesic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
